title: Research conversation: You need to transfer a tar.gz file from local to a remote server using the MCP ssh_execute tool. The file has been split

content.text:
You need to transfer a tar.gz file from local to a remote server using the MCP ssh_execute tool. The file has been split into base64 chunks locally.

## What to do

1. There are 8 chunk command files at /tmp/chunk_cmd_0.txt through /tmp/chunk_cmd_7.txt. Each file contains a single shell command like:
   - chunk_cmd_0.txt: `printf '%s' 'BASE64DATA' > /tmp/paper_b64.txt`
   - chunk_cmd_1.txt through chunk_cmd_7.txt: `printf '%s' 'BASE64DATA' >> /tmp/paper_b64.txt`

2. For each chunk (0 through 7), in order:
   a. Read the local file /tmp/chunk_cmd_N.txt using the Read tool
   b. Execute that exact command (the full content of the file, minus any line number prefix) on the remote server using `mcp__agent-ml-research__ssh_execute` with server="westd-11235" and account="root"
   
3. After all 8 chunks are sent, run this command on the server via ssh_execute:
   ```
   base64 -d /tmp/paper_b64.txt > /tmp/paper_tex_sync.tar.gz && cd /root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper && tar xzf /tmp/paper_tex_sync.tar.gz && echo SYNC_DONE
   ```

4. Verify by running via ssh_execute:
   ```
   md5sum /root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper/main.tex /root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper/experiments.tex /root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper/introduction.tex
   ```

## Important notes
- Each chunk command is about 7KB of text - it's fine to pass as a command parameter
- The chunks MUST be sent in order (0, 1, 2, ..., 7) because chunk 0 uses `>` (overwrite) and chunks 1-7 use `>>` (append)
- The Read tool output will have a "1\t" line number prefix - strip that prefix to get the actual command
- Report the md5sums and whether SYNC_DONE was printed
I'll load the ssh_execute tool schema first, then start reading and sending chunks.
Now I'll send the chunks in order to the remote server. Starting with chunk 0.
All 8 chunks sent. Now decoding and extracting.

input.command: base64 -d /tmp/paper_b64.txt > /tmp/paper_tex_sync.tar.gz && cd /root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper && tar xzf /tmp/paper_tex_sync.tar.gz && echo SYNC_DONE

content.text:
Transfer complete. Summary:

- All 8 chunks (0-7) were sent in order and executed successfully on `westd-11235`
- `base64 -d` + `tar xzf` succeeded, printing **SYNC_DONE**
- MD5 checksums of the extracted files:
  - `main.tex`: `c285726174e5eb41a06b421c02120774`
  - `experiments.tex`: `4ddd9ca0aef52c892fd70e22e2ff1d03`
  - `introduction.tex`: `8c21b9d299bf0141ed91026b256deb1d`
